newsitem.title: UK: London stock mkt, RNS closed on Dec 25, 26, Jan 1.
newsitem.headline: London stock mkt, RNS closed on Dec 25, 26, Jan 1.

text.p: The London Stock Exchange will be closed for trading on December 25 and 26 and January 1, 1997 and will trade only in the mornings of December 24, 27 and 31.
On these half days the bourse will close at 1230 GMT, instead of its usual closing time of 1630 GMT.
The exchange's Regulatory News Service (RNS) will be closed on the same days as the bourse, the stock exchange said.
On December 24, 27 and 31 the RNS service will close at 1330 GMT, it said, adding that announcements must be lodged with its office by 1230 GMT to ensure release that day.
Normal operating hours will apply for RNS on December 30, January 2 and January 3.
